Scene:
你不是当数学家，而是当哲学家，不能当卖东西的人。所以他们又搬家。在他们第三个家，孟子学了怎么祭拜。妈妈感觉这个地方适合他们，告诉了孟子：我们找到了最后的家。在这儿妈妈让儿子从早到晚学习，他难怪成为有名的哲学家。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他难怪成为有名的哲学家：难怪后来他成为……

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Conjunction): 他难怪成为有名的哲学家：所以他后来成为有名的哲学家，Use 所以 to connect the cause—his mother made him study all day—with the result; 后来 places his achievement later in the narrative.
Run 2: Coherence (Conjunction): 他难怪：所以，他，so links his long period of study with the result; 难怪 is used when explaining why something is unsurprising, rather than simply showing a cause-and-effect sequence.

output.reason: Both runs identify the inappropriate use of 难怪 and replace it with 所以 to express the intended cause-and-effect relation.
